30 June 2026 Release

Share This Post

Maintenance

Service Outage Expiration Date

Introducing Service Outage expirations! Schedule an expiration date for your Service Outage to ensure it is automatically removed from the system at a pre-determined date. To extend a Service Outage, simply edit the Service Outage prior to the scheduled expiration date.

Leasing

Access Leads from Calendar View

Anyone Home users can now navigate to a lead’s guest card directly from events scheduled for them in the Schedule’s Calendar view. Simply select the event and click on the new Open Guest Card button to be automatically routed to their lead details page.

Admin Setting for Lead Display Date Default

Using the new My Leads Display setting, Anyone Home Admin users can now determine whether the My Leads view defaults to showing ‘All’ leads or the last ‘90 days’ of leads.

CRM

Tour Scheduling Window Extends to 60 Days

For lease-up communities under construction or properties that request advanced notice for showings, Anyone Home has extended how far in advance prospects and agents can schedule a tour from 30 days to 60 days.

Quotes

Override Integrated Quote Fees

Adjust integrated property fees with the click of a button! Anyone Home now allows Admin users to manually edit fees created via integrations. Use this feature to adjust fee fields in Anyone Home that don’t pull in from the originating PMS.

Quote Floor Plan and Unit Specials

Customize quotable concessions! When creating a quote inside Anyone Home, users will now have the option of including floor plan and unit specials for the quoted floorplan or unit.

KPIs

Call Score KPI Chart Enhancement

Introducing even more Call Score KPI visuals! In addition to the existing Line Graph option, the Call Score KPI can now be configured as a Donut Chart.
